patterns.name: Opening sung melody - brief excerpt
patterns.description: The first two bars include only a brief opening sung-melody excerpt, played on guitar above a reduced bass accompaniment. It is in the lower guitar register, an octave below the published vocal staff. The tied note across the barline is not struck again. Other bars and subsequent verses remain accompaniment; the complete vocal melody is not included. Explicit fret -1 actions damp the previous melody string when the tune moves to a lower string. The original short lyric cue stays on this occurrence.

parts.notes: Simplified practice accompaniment, not a note-for-note transcription. Standard tuning, no capo; practice tempo 76 BPM. Each bar is 4/4 with sixteen sixteenth-note slots. The fingerpicking sounds on every eighth note (1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &). Thumb plays the lowest unmuted string; fingers play the indicated relative upper strings. Chord changes at slots 0, 8 and 12 mean beats 1, 3 and 4. The picking pattern restarts its bass on beat 3; a beat-4 chord change continues the upper notes. Lyric text is only a short opening cue; add your own full text. Some shapes use a barre, marked b in the grip encoding. Progression: A - E/G# | F#m - A/E | D/F# - E7sus4 - E7 | A.

Two passes of A - E/G# | F#m - A/E | D/F# - A/E | E - E7. Each pair lasts two beats per chord. Reused for the vocal verses and instrumental accompaniment. The arrangement keeps independent lyric cues for each occurrence.

Simplified six-bar turnaround: F#m - C#/E# | A7/E - F#7 | Bm7 | Bm7/E | A | E7sus4 - E7. Two chords in a bar receive two beats each; a single chord lasts all four beats. This is a practice form with regularized durations.
Simplified eight-bar bridge: C - G/B | Am - D/F# | G - D/F# | Em - D/F# | C - G/B | Am - D/F# | G - D/F# | E - E7. Each chord receives two beats. Keep the same fingerpicking pulse.
A - E/G# | F#m - A/E | Bm7 - Bm7/E | A. Fingerpick the first three bars. Strum A once at the start of the last bar and let it ring for four beats.
